section: When FBAL equal 1 in diagnostic data No. 200(servo alarm No.416 is being generated)
markdown:
|   ALD |   EXP | Alarm details                                              |
|-------|-------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|     1 |     0 | Built-in pulse coder disconnection (hard ware)             |
|     1 |     1 | Separately installed pulse coder disconnection (hard ware) |
|     0 |     0 | Pulse coder is not connected due to software               |
